original_test_intent: Verify the approved NIC can be safely installed, secured and removed in every supported PCIe slot without connector, bracket, riser, cable or chassis interference.
original_method: Qualified operator powers off/removes power, follows ESD/service procedure and tests each signed supported slot individually, recording tactile fit, latch/bracket/fastener engagement, clearances and strain with photos before restoration.
manual_activity: Qualified operator performs all chassis opening, power removal, ESD-controlled NIC insertion/removal, tactile/visual inspection and per-slot photography.
required_inputs: Approved NIC PN/SKU/bracket and SUT/chassis/riser/cable identities
Complete supported PCIe-slot matrix and mechanical drawings/clearances
Service manual, power-off verification, ESD controls and qualified operator
Approved mounting hardware/torque and photo checklist
Damage/no-POST recovery and final assembly policy
safety_requirements: Fully remove power and verify safe state before opening chassis
Use ESD controls and approved handling/mounting procedure
Do not force a card, bend bracket, strain cables or continue after interference/damage
Stop on tight/loose fit, misalignment, bent pins, missing fastener, blocked airflow or cable strain
No hot-plug, automatic power-on, reseat or recovery
agent_execution_scope: Organize operator photos/checklist and optional post-boot PCIe/link/driver evidence
Map each observation to the signed supported-slot matrix
Do not handle hardware, infer tactile fit from enumeration or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide supported-slot/mechanical specification and acceptable fit/clearance/torque criteria
Ensure operator safety and decide disposition of any interference
Review per-slot evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no agent command can perform the defining physical fit test; operator action is authoritative.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual power-off ESD-controlled installation/removal and inspection in each approved supported slot; optional read-only lspci/link evidence after safe boot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All supported slots, plug/unplug fit, cover/cable/riser interference and5/5 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-slot checklist with before/during/after photos and explicit insertion, retention, clearance, strain and damage observations.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identities, safe handling, traceable evidence and stop/recovery boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None; remote OS detection is only corroboration and cannot replace mechanical assessment.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Insertion-force perception is operator-dependent; repeated cycles can wear connectors, and a card may enumerate despite unsafe bracket or cable interference.

project_override_considerations: Only slots named by the approved platform matrix are exercised; unsupported slots are documented rather than tried, and no force/clearance tolerance is invented.
expected_evidence: Operator/date, power-off/ESD confirmation and service procedure revision
Insertion/removal fit, latch/bracket/fastener/torque, cover/cable/airflow clearance and damage checklist
Optional post-boot lspci/link/driver/dmesg/SEL per final approved configuration
Restored assembly/final state and engineer verdict per slot

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require physical installation and mechanical inspection across every supported slot; exact matrix and tolerances are project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Physical SUT, operator, slot matrix and safe procedure can be supplied; this is manual rather than inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Turns a general physical check into a traceable per-slot mechanical and safety evidence contract without substituting OS enumeration.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe electrical detection proves contact after boot but says nothing about excessive insertion force, incomplete latch engagement, bracket preload, cover collision or cable bend radius. Those are spatial and tactile properties that can damage hardware even when the device enumerates, so each approved slot needs operator observation before any optional powered corroboration.
